item.title: From prison to two courtrooms: KZN mass murderer Chonco's extraordinary legal day
item.description: CONVICTED mass murderer Thabo Chonco who is already serving five life sentences for the mass murder of a Mbambo family in Bulwer, appeared in two separate courts on the same day on Monday for the murder of ten members of the Memela family in Mbali at the Pietermaritzburg High Court and was later moved to the city's regional court for the murder of DA chief whip Nhlalayenza Ndlovu.
